pool: Ready players can be drafted. More than 12 can be ready; each match has 12 players.
attendance: Ready: available to draft. Sit out: skip one match, then return. Away: unavailable tonight. Current team slots stay assigned when availability changes. Undrafted players join or leave the captain pool immediately.
select12: Mark the first 12 roster players ready for this match.
mode: Balanced random nudges team estimates toward 50%. Random has no balance bias. Both draw 12 ready players and offer two heroes each. Captains use snake picks. Manual teams support drag and drop.
patch: The latest effective patch is selected. SteamDB titles are kept, including No title. Untitled builds include their BuildID.
bias: Higher values prefer closer team estimates. This changes team assignment, not who sits out.
statistics: Hide player ratings, game counts, and team estimates on the draft screen. Ratings still balance teams and appear in Stats.
estimate: Win chance estimated from overall ratings and uncertainty. It does not measure individual contribution.
rating: Conservative OpenSkill rating: mu minus three times sigma. Fewer recorded games mean greater uncertainty.
heroes: Offer two unused heroes per player. Options are reserved across the lineup. Choose one option each before recording. Preferences do not affect the draw.
hero: Choose a unique hero. Random draws two available options for this player. Banned and reserved heroes are excluded.
firstBan: The first banning side gets the last player pick. Captains are already assigned. Second bans occur after three drafted picks per team.
drag: Drag a ready player to an empty slot. In captain mode, drop on the side whose turn it is. Use the pick buttons or team selectors with a keyboard.
result: Complete both teams, choose 12 unique heroes, then select a winner and record the match.
preferences: Preference values: -1 avoid, 0 neutral, 1 comfortable, 2 preferred, 3 favorite. They are saved for reference, not used in random draws.
profileImport: Import one player's preference file. Choose an existing player to update, or add them as new. Match records and ratings stay intact.
records: Export a backup of all records. Import replaces the current records after validation and confirmation.
correction: A result correction keeps the previous winner in the edit history and recalculates ratings.
patchRefresh: Load the shipped patch catalog. Patch times are UTC. Existing patch records remain if loading fails.
timeline: Ratings carry across patches. Vertical markers show patch changes. The band shows one sigma around the conservative rating.
prediction: Brier score measures prediction error. Lower is better. Predictions do not show whether captain choices caused a win.
winnerEstimate: Average draft-time probability assigned to the team that won.
ratingModel: OpenSkill Plackett–Luce uses team wins and losses. It does not measure individual contribution. Fewer games mean greater uncertainty. Patch filters show records from that patch and ratings at its end.
replace: Export a backup before starting fresh. Empty JSON downloads the configured starting records.
notes: Optional player notes. Notes are included in the player's preference file.
profile: Fill in your name and hero preferences. Download the JSON file and send it to the lobby leader. This page does not edit the leader's roster.
